words.gloss_range: second first-person seeing verb with object pronoun, gathering the inventory into a group and introducing its state

words.prose: {{ar:رَأَيْتُهُمْ}} ({{tr:raʾaytuhum}}) is the hinge from inventory to meaning. The suffix compresses the eleven stars, sun, and moon into one rationalized acting group, while the second seeing verb reports their state rather than adding objects. Form I keeps Yusuf as observer, the repetition binds first seeing for list and second seeing for relation, the pronoun closure leads into the target phrase, and the seeing-plus-prostration field points toward fulfillment (12:100).

words.prose: {{ar:سَاجِدِينَ}} ({{tr:sājidīna}}) is the ayah's landing word: the list resolves into a shared ongoing posture. The participle can work as state or second object, agrees with the gathered group, and presents an observed state rather than a command or completed act. Its root image permits celestial lowering or orientation without ordinary bodily mechanics, its normally divine-weighted prostration field is redirected inside Yusuf's dream with human-elevation parallels such as 17:61, and its final long-vowel closure points to the warning (12:5) and fulfilled prostration (12:100).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The father-address at words 4-5 encloses the doubled seeing at words 7 and 13 within direct speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: Vocal saying transfers a dream from Yusuf's interior into a paternal relation; the repeated seeing first opens the scene and then singles out its orientation toward him.

changed_reading.before: A child simply lists the content of a dream.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is an act of selective disclosure: an interior event becomes consequential knowledge inside a trusted father-son channel.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The celestial nouns at words 10-12 are resumed as rational plural agents and joined to the masculine plural posture at word 15, all directed toward Yusuf.
baseline_models.mechanism: The syntax converts a sky inventory into a social assembly. Distinct lights become responsive agents whose shared lowering establishes a many-to-one relational field.

activation_trace.role: The literal star supplies the plural celestial field that is subsequently personified.
The sun and its light supply a singular major luminary within the responsive assembly.
The moon and its light supply the second singular luminary paired with the sun.
Lowering and submission give all the personified lights one coordinated social action.

changed_reading.before: The dream is an extraordinary astronomical spectacle.
changed_reading.after: The dream recodes cosmic lights as a responsive society, so celestial order becomes a model of relation and recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compound count at words 8-9 preserves an exact plurality while the final construction directs every counted body along one vector toward Yusuf.
baseline_models.mechanism: Exact counting resists an undifferentiated crowd, while the latent group branch in the second count term and the common posture organize discrete members into a collective with one orientation.

activation_trace.role: The unit used in compound counting fixes the first component of the exact eleven.
The ten-count completes the explicit numerical plurality rather than leaving it generic.
The branch of a group sharing one affair gives the counted plurality a latent social body.
Common submission converts individually counted members into a coordinated many-to-one arrangement.

changed_reading.before: Eleven is only the quantity of stars.
changed_reading.after: The exact count draws a relational geometry: many distinct members remain countable yet converge in one shared orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Seeing is stated before the celestial list and repeated after it immediately before the relational predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first seeing opens a private dream scene; the second is not merely redundant but pivots from objects seen to their directed action, making relation itself the decisive content.

activation_trace.role: An unexpressed saying supplies the latent interior state from which the spoken report emerges.
Dream-seeing supplies both occurrences and lets repetition segment scene from relation.
Showing and making visible activate the second seeing as a reveal of what the listed bodies are doing.

changed_reading.before: The repeated seeing is emphatic restatement.
changed_reading.after: The repetition is an interpretive hinge: the dream's force lies not in which lights appear but in the relation their action reveals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence marks visible signs, tracked narration, hidden impartation, and prior unawareness. This makes the compact dream a trace whose images can be progressively unpacked by the narrative rather than a detachable marvel.

activation_trace.role: The dream supplies the compact image-sequence that the framing cues recast as a narrative sign.
A manifest sign supplies the framing category under which the dream can carry meaning beyond its surface.
Following a trace supplies the narrative method by which later details can track back to the dream.
Knowledge imparted in concealment supplies a hidden-to-manifest movement parallel to the private dream becoming speech.
Unawareness outside alert perception supplies the epistemic absence that signs and hidden knowledge overcome.

structural_cues: The packet moves from signs and a clear book in 12:1 through understanding in 12:2 and tracked narration plus hidden impartation in 12:3 directly into the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign, trace-following, hidden knowledge, and unawareness; I infer that 12:4 functions as a compressed program for the local narrative. A live alternative is that these cues frame the whole recitation without assigning special programmatic force to each dream image.

changed_reading.before: The dream begins the plot as one private episode.
changed_reading.after: The dream is a compact sign and narrative seed whose relational geometry is designed to be reread as events expose its latent structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate prohibition against retelling the vision identifies disclosure itself as the point where a private image enters a hostile kin network. Speech does not merely report the dream; it can activate the social future represented inside it.

activation_trace.role: Audible saying supplies the focus action whose circulation becomes dangerous.
Dream-vision supplies the sensitive content whose audience must be controlled.
Sequentially recounting news supplies the prohibited transmission mechanism.
Brotherhood supplies the intimate but unsafe recipient network.
Concealed maneuver supplies the predicted conversion of heard meaning into counteraction.

structural_cues: The very next ayah repeats vision and recounting, specifies the brothers as audience, and gives scheming as the consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a ban on retelling, a kin audience, and a scheme; I infer a causal arrow from disclosure of implied hierarchy to defensive action. The live alternative is a general warning about the brothers' disposition rather than a claim that speech itself activates events.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf's speech is a transparent preface to the dream.
changed_reading.after: Yusuf's speech is the first consequential event: it releases a latent social hierarchy into an audience capable of resisting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Selection, learned disclosure, return to outcome, renewed reports, completion, and blessing turn the dream into the opening exercise of a vocation: reading how images and reports come to their eventual form inside a paternal lineage.

activation_trace.role: Dream-vision supplies the first symbolic material on which the promised interpretive learning can operate.
Fatherhood and nurture supply the relational channel through which the vocation is first recognized.
Selection with nearness supplies the transition from unusual dreamer to specially cultivated reader.
Disclosure to a knower supplies learned recognition rather than automatic decoding.
Return toward an outcome supplies the temporal operation by which dream-images are read through what they become.
Kin who return to one another supply a lineage dimension to the same outcome-oriented operation.
Speech renewed as report supplies the material whose outcomes Yusuf is promised to learn.
Arrival at completion supplies a horizon in which the dream's unfinished geometry can become actual.
Good condition and favor supply the positive telos attached to completion.

structural_cues: In 12:6 the sequence runs from selection to teaching the outcome of reports, then to completion of favor across fathers and descendants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selection, teaching, outcome-return, reports, completion, and paternal continuity; I infer that the dream inaugurates an interpretive vocation rather than merely predicting honor. A live alternative is that 12:6 promises later gifts in response to the dream without making the dream itself a training program.

changed_reading.before: The dream forecasts a future posture of others toward Yusuf.
changed_reading.after: The dream also commissions a mode of knowing: Yusuf's path will involve carrying images and reports forward until their hidden outcomes become legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated brotherhood, the self-description as a mutually supporting group, and collective resolve activate the eleven stars as a possible sibling body. Their present coalition against Yusuf then becomes the negative image of the dream's future common orientation.

activation_trace.role: The compound unit fixes the explicit eleven that can be tested against a later human plurality.
A group sharing one affair supplies the social potential latent in the count.
The eleven stars supply the countable dream-body available for kin mapping.
Brotherhood supplies the first explicit candidate relation for the counted stars.
A surrounding, mutually supporting group supplies the brothers' present collective shape.
Collusion on one matter supplies the group's coordinated anti-Yusuf action.

structural_cues: Brotherhood recurs in 12:5, 12:7, and 12:8; the brothers call themselves a group in 12:8 and 12:14, then reach collective resolve in 12:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact celestial count beside a repeatedly named and coordinated brother-group; I infer a candidate alignment between the stars and that kin collective. The count-equivalence is not stated in the window, so the alternative of an unassigned celestial plurality remains live, and the sun and moon remain unresolved.

changed_reading.before: The eleven stars are an unexplained celestial plurality.
changed_reading.after: The eleven stars become a possible image of the sibling collective, with its hostile present alignment held against the dream's opposite shared posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers name unequal love and seek to empty the father's face for themselves. This activates the lowered, sustained-gaze branch of prostration: the dream can stage not only submission but a redistribution of undivided attention toward Yusuf.

activation_trace.role: Sustained looking with a lowered, still eye supplies an attention-bearing alternative within the prostrating posture.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the scarce attachment over which the brothers compete.
The surrounding allied group supplies the rival many who feel displaced by a one-to-one attachment.
Emptiness and cleared space supply the brothers' plan to remove Yusuf from the father's attention field.
The face and what fronts another supply the concrete surface of paternal regard they want directed to themselves.

structural_cues: The directional focus construction 'for me' in 12:4 is answered by 'for you' around the father's face in 12:9.
The context moves from comparative love in 12:8 to a plan for exclusive access to the father's face in 12:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-held love, an allied group, a cleared face, and a prostration branch involving lowered sustained gaze; I infer that attention is one medium of the dream's orientation. The live alternative is the ordinary bodily submission model, which remains fully active and need not be replaced.

changed_reading.before: Prostration signifies only rank and bodily submission.
changed_reading.after: Prostration may simultaneously picture an attention reversal: the many and the great lights direct toward Yusuf the regard his brothers think he has monopolized.

context_deltas.mechanism: High celestial bodies lower toward Yusuf while the brothers propose casting him toward earth and into a hidden well. In the actual descent, concealed knowledge promises that he will later report their action, coupling spatial reversal with a reversal of who controls the account.

activation_trace.role: Stars in the sky supply the high register from which the dream's bodies lower.
Bowing and bending supply the dream's downward motion toward Yusuf.
The below opposed to the sky supplies the first explicit counter-direction for Yusuf.
Casting something away supplies the forced descent that opposes the dream's voluntary lowering.
A depression in which something disappears supplies depth and visual removal.
The unlined cut well supplies the material bottom of the brothers' counter-image.
Knowledge imparted in concealment places a hidden upward future inside the moment of descent.
A delivered report supplies the promised reversal from object of the plot to narrator of it.

structural_cues: The proposal in 12:9-10 moves from earth to casting to hidden depth and well; 12:15 repeats the depth and inserts concealed revelation plus a future report.
The focus tells a vision to the father; the well revelation promises a later telling to the brothers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sky, lowering, earth, casting, hidden depth, well, concealed knowledge, and future reporting; I infer a deliberate counter-descent in which present lowering of Yusuf is answered by future lowering toward him. A live alternative is that the vertical correspondence is plot geometry without predictive symbolic force.

changed_reading.before: The prostrating lights indicate a future elevation in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: The dream establishes a reversible vertical system: others lower toward Yusuf in the vision just before the plot lowers him into hidden earth, while a future act of telling is planted at the bottom.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene assembles performed grief, a claim about belief and truth, a shirt, blood, and a false description. It reverses a naive hierarchy of evidence: the private dream is truth-bearing, while the public visible display is manufactured.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the broad epistemic claim that the later display will test.

Rendering a thing by description supplies the brothers' verbal overlay on the staged object.

structural_cues: The sequence arrives at night with crying, anticipates disbelief, claims truth, presents an object marked by false blood, and ends by naming what the brothers describe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an inward dream and a later multisensory display explicitly marked false; I infer that the local sequence contrasts truth-bearing vision with engineered visibility. A live alternative is that 12:16-18 tests the father's discernment without establishing a wider contrast between dream and ocular evidence.

changed_reading.before: The doubled 'I saw' is simply a strong claim that the dream occurred.
changed_reading.after: The doubled seeing becomes an epistemic pole: inward vision can disclose relation truthfully, while crying, blood, clothing, and confident description can collaborate in a lie.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a proverbial dispersal branch of the star word rather than its astronomical sense. It remains anchored because the focus explicitly gathers eleven stars under one posture while the context gathers the brothers upon a contrary action. Downstream prose should render dispersal-versus-assembly as a structural oscillation, not as a claim that the stars literally scatter in the dream.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Eleven stars at word 10 are syntactically gathered into one prostrating plural at word 15.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal under every star supplies a latent centrifugal tendency inside the eleven-star plurality.
One common submission gathers the potentially scattered bodies into a shared orientation.
Joining what was separate supplies the brothers' own gathered movement, though toward concealment rather than recognition.
Collusion on one affair supplies the hostile counter-assembly to the dream's prostrating assembly.

changed_reading.before: The stars form a single already-coherent group.
changed_reading.after: The star-field can hold dispersal and gathering at once: the narrative group coheres to hide Yusuf, while the dream gathers the same kind of plurality into recognition of him.

strongest_changes: The immediate warning turns Yusuf's report from neutral narration into a dangerous social act whose disclosure can activate resistance.
The brothers' struggle over love and the father's face activates prostration as an economy of gaze and attention alongside bodily submission.
Earth, casting, hidden depth, well, concealed knowledge, and future reporting turn the celestial posture into a sky-to-well counter-descent and a reversal of narrative control.
Performed crying and false blood reverse the expected hierarchy between inward dream and visible proof: private vision is truth-bearing while public evidence is staged.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled seeing, exact compound count, rationalized celestial plural, and directional posture support several coexisting mechanisms. The local context does not merely assign referents; it changes speech into exposure, count into contested kinship, prostration into attention, and celestial lowering into an answer to forced descent. Non-dominant and material branches also preserve contained water-bearing, resistant-sun, lunar-wager, and dispersal readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The context strongly invites but does not explicitly settle the identity of the eleven stars, and it leaves the sun and moon unassigned.
The sustained-gaze branch of prostration supports an attention model without displacing bodily submission.
The water-bearing vision, resistant sun, lunar wager, and scattered-star models are packet-backed branch activations but remain deliberately form-distant.
The signs-and-trace frame may program the focus dream specifically or may orient the pericope more generally.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A dream turns celestial plurality into social orientation.** ر ء ي B003 (dream vision), ك و ك ب B001, ش م س B001, and ق م ر B001 supply the celestial figures; س ج د B001 (lowering in humble submission) supplies their relation. I infer that the dream maps a dispersed family field onto a common orientation toward Yusuf. The ayah reads as a relational diagram whose social referents remain initially latent.
2. **Seeing is doubled because the vision is also later recognition.** The repeated `رأيت` keeps ر ء ي B003 active, but the full packet activates B001 (seeing by eye or insight) when the scene becomes embodied at 12:100. The lexical repetition allows both dream-reception and retrospective insight without collapsing them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100 explicitly named the embodied prostration scene as the dream’s تأويل, confirming the social-pattern reading and adding throne-space to the celestial arrangement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A dream that immediately demands judgment.** The repeated `ر ء ي:B003` is “dream vision”; nearby `ر ء ي:B002` contributes “opinion and reflective judgment.” The fixed ayah twice marks seeing, while 12:5 converts what was seen into a decision about whom to tell and 12:6 places it under interpretation. The packet provides dream, repetition, warning, and interpretation; I infer that a vision’s social handling is part of perceiving it well. The ayah reads as both reception of an image and the beginning of deliberation over its consequences.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:100 explicitly calls the family scene the earlier dream's *taʾwīl* and says it was made true, removing the initial uncertainty about whether the vision would become an enacted social arrangement.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gökteki Ay'ı, onun ışığını ve bu ışıkla aydınlanan geceyi aynı anlam alanında açıkça birleştirir. Ay adının hilalden sonraki günlerde ya da dolunay evresinde kullanılması kaynaklar arasındaki kapsam farkıdır; gök cismi ile ışık çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, Ay'ın yalın adını ışık, aydınlık gece ve doğma bildiren yapıya bağlı kullanımlardan ayırarak birlikte gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Gökteki Ay ile ondan yayılan ışığı ve bu ışığın geceyi aydınlatmasını anlatır. Bazı kaynaklar Ay adının hilalden sonraki günlerde, bazıları ise özellikle dolunayda kullanıldığını belirtir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, gökte görülen Ay adlı gök cismidir.
Ay'ın ışığı, bu ışıkla aydınlanan gece ve Ay'ın bir topluluk üzerine doğması aynı dala bağlı kullanımlardır.
Ay adının başlangıç sınırı hilalden sonraki birkaç geceyle, belirgin evresi ise dolunayla ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gökteki Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece üzerinde birleşir; adın ayın hangi evresinden itibaren öne çıktığı konusunda hilal sonrası ile dolunay arasında farklı sınırlar verir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القمر قمر السماء سمى قمرا لبياضه (maqayis)؛ القمراء ضوء القمر وليلة مقمرة (ayn;tahdhib)؛ القمر بعد ثلاث ليال إلى آخر الشهر (sihah)؛ القمر قمر السماء يقال عند الامتلاء (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأقمر والقمراء في الحمار والأتان والسحاب والهجان، والقمرة كلون يضرب إلى الخضرة أو البياض الشديد.
يدخل فيه إتيان الشخص في القمراء، وخروج الأسد أو الصياد يطلب الصيد ليلا، وصيد الطير أو الظباء حين تغشى أبصارها بالليل أو الضوء.
يدخل فيه قمر التمر وأقمر التمر إذا أصابه البرد قبل أن ينضج فذهبت حلاوته وطعمه.
يدخل فيه قمر الرجل إذا لم يبصر أو حار بصره في الثلج.
يدخل فيه قمرت القربة إذا أصابها من القمر كالاحتراق أو دخل الماء بين الأدمة والبشرة فأصابها فساد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği para veya mal ortaya konan talih oyununda karşılaşma ve rakibi yenmedir; rakip arama ve hileyle aldatma bununla bağlantılı uzantılardır. Çerçevedeki aldatma unsuru bütün oyun eylemlerinin zorunlu özelliği gibi sunulmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, oyun adını ve karşılıklı oynama çekirdeğini rakip arama, yenme ve aldatma bildiren yapılardan ayırarak korur.

concept_map.definition: Para ya da mal gibi bir değer ortaya koyulan talih oyununda karşılıklı oynamayı ve rakibi yenmeyi anlatır. Oynayacak rakip arama ve birini hileyle aldatarak üstün gelme anlamları bu çekirdeğe bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir değer ortaya koyulan talih oyununda tarafların karşılıklı oynamasıdır.
Bir rakip aramak, onunla karşılaşmak ve oyunda onu yenmek eylem zincirinin özel aşamalarıdır.
Birini hileyle aldatıp ondan üstün çıkmak, oyun çekirdeğinden gelişen fakat her oyunda zorunlu olmayan uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı talih oyunu ve rakibi yenme çekirdeğinde birleşir; toplu ifade rakip arama, övünme yarışı ve hileyle aldatma ayrıntılarını da farklı ağırlıklarla kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın temelini alçalma ve boyun eğme olarak kurar; alnı yere koymayı da bu çekirdeğin belirli bir bedensel gerçekleşmesi olarak açıkça verir. Bu nedenle geçici çerçeve, hem genel bağlılığı hem de yere kapanma hareketini kaynak sınırları içinde doğru biçimde taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çıplak daldır; tanım temel eylem ile onun alnı yere koyma biçimini kapsar, yer ve araç adlarından anlam devralmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir buyruğa ya da üstün görülen bir varlığa karşı alçalıp boyun eğmek; bunun belirli bedensel biçiminde alnı yere koymaktır. Boyun eğme isteyerek de zorunlu bir düzene bağlı olarak da gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, kişinin kendini aşağı konumda tutarak boyun eğmesi ve bağlılık göstermesidir.
Belirli törensel beden hareketinde kişi alnını yere koyarak bu boyun eğmeyi görünür kılar.
Boyun eğme, kişinin seçimine dayalı olabileceği gibi kendisine verilmiş düzene zorunlu bağlılık biçiminde de düşünülebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi alçalma ve boyun eğmedir; alnın yere konması bu genel çekirdeğin törensel ve bedensel bir gerçekleşmesi olarak açıklanır. Ayrıca bağlılığın seçime dayalı ya da zorunlu olabileceği belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: alçalıp boyun eğme ve alnı yere koyma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem genel bağlılık çekirdeğini hem de bunun yere kapanarak gerçekleşen belirli beden biçimini birlikte anlatmak gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Alçalma, boyun eğme ve alnı yere koyma bileşenlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlılık ve kendini aşağı konumda tutma öndeyken, belirli beden hareketinin söylenmesi gerekmeyen bağlamlarda doğaldır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karışık ve çıplak olmayan türdedir; insanın eğilmesi, bineğin alçaltılması ve yüklü ağacın yatması ayrı biçimlere bağlı yüzlerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın başını alçaltıp gövdesini öne eğmesi ya da binmeye elverişli olsun diye bir bineğin alçaltılmasıdır. Cansız uzantıda ise ağır meyve yükünün ağacı eğip yana yatırması anlatılır.

facets.statement: İnsanla ilgili temel kullanım, başı alçaltıp gövdeyi öne doğru eğmektir.
Ettirgen kullanımda binek hayvanı, üzerine binilebilmesi için aşağı alçaltılır.
Bir açıklama, insan duruşunu özellikle belden öne eğilmiş olma biçimiyle karşılar.
Ağaca aktarılan kullanımda ağır meyve yükü gövdeyi veya dalları eğip yana yatırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başı alçaltma ve gövdeyi eğme çekirdeğinde birleşir; bineği binmek için alçaltma bu çekirdeğin ettirgen biçimidir. Meyve yüküyle ağacın eğilmesi ise aynı aşağı yönlü biçimin cansız varlığa uzantısıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bakışı aşağı yönelmiş durumda uzun süre tutmayı, gözün devinimsizliğini ve göz kapaklarındaki gevşekliği birlikte tanıklar. Geçici çerçeve, kısa bir bakıştan veya yalnızca baş eğmeden farklı olan bu süreklilik ve durgunluk bileşenlerini doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karışık ve çıplak olmayan türdedir; eylem adı ile durgun göz ve gevşek bakışlı kadınları anlatan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.
